findings.description: campaign_cases.py was edited about 48 s after campaign35 started, and campaign35's evidence hash was taken at the end of the run (EVIDENCE_HASHES.json 01:29:53), so it records the RC2D file instead of the RC2C code that produced the rows. The RC2C version (c8add78f..., 27009 bytes) is not kept anywhere under certification/, so `sha256sum -c HARNESS_RC2C.sha256` now fails for campaign_cases.py and nobody can re-hash or diff it. The rows themselves show RC2C behaviour: campaign35 ignite_tnt has no use_flint_and_steel requirement, and one orchestrator process imported the cases at 11:38Z. So this group's verdicts are not affected, but the provenance record is inaccurate.
